data.gender_notes: Amul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Amul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Amruth' which means 'Nectar of God'. In Hindu mythology, the Gods churned the ocean (Samudra Manthan) to obtain Amruth, the elixir of immortality. The name Amul carries the meaning “Nectar of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amul usually hope their child will grow to embody nectar of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
